description_short: Hire a boat from Buckland Jetty to explore the beautiful Mallacoota Inlet at your own pace.
description_long: Located at Buckland's Jetty, offering a range of hire boats suitable for fishing, cruising, and enjoying the beautiful Mallacoota Lakes system.

images.alt_text: Boats for hire at Buckland Jetty.

description_short: Free morning of coffee, nibbles, a chat and maybe some trivia, at the Muddie.
description_long: A Reclink morning at the Mudbrick Pavilion: coffee, nibbles, a chat and maybe some trivia. Free, and no need to book or be any good at quizzes. Turn up.
meetingTimes: First Friday of the month, 10am to 12 noon

source.note: Venue, time and that it is free from the Coota community calendar; the monthly frequency from Colin.

description_short: Second-hand books at the Mudbrick Pavilion, with coffee, cards and a chat.
description_long: Josef's Bookshop at the Mudbrick Pavilion, open two sessions a week. Thursday mornings run as coffee, cards, games and a chat as much as a bookshop, and Friday afternoons carry Reclink events alongside the shelves. Volunteer run, so it opens for those sessions rather than all week.
notes_seasonal: Thursday 10am-1pm and Friday 1-5pm. Thursday is the coffee-and-cards session; Friday afternoon has Reclink events on as well.

source.note: Times and venue from the Coota community calendar, June to December 2025.

description_short: Hire boats and kayaks from Buckland Drive - perfect for fishing or exploring the inlet.
description_long: A wide range of tinnies, cruisers, and kayaks for hire to explore Mallacoota Inlet. Easy pickup at Buckland Drive, close to the main wharf. Book ahead in peak periods.

description_short: Historic WWII bunker and museum showcasing local and military history.
description_long: Discover Mallacoota's fascinating military history at the RSL Bunker Museum, a restored WWII advanced operations bunker. The museum features displays on local history, maritime history, and Australia's military heritage.

images.alt_text: The entrance to the Mallacoota RSL Bunker Museum.

notes_seasonal: Open Tuesday mornings, 9.30am with last entry 11.30am. Other openings depend on volunteer availability, so ring before making a special trip.

description_short: Your one-stop shop for surf gear, apparel, and beach essentials in Mallacoota.
description_long: Stocking a wide range of surfboards, wetsuits, surf hardware, beachwear, clothing, footwear, sunglasses, and local Mallacoota merchandise. Surf hire potentially available.

description_short: Exquisite, locally sourced pearls and fine jewellery from the Wilderness Coast.
description_long: Specialising in unique pearl jewellery featuring pearls sourced locally from the waters around Mallacoota. Offers necklaces, earrings, bracelets, and custom pieces.
notes_seasonal: Check website or contact for viewing/purchase options.

description_short: Enjoy scenic cruises and fishing charters on the historic MV Loch-Ard with a local expert.
description_long: Take a scenic cruise or fishing charter aboard the historic vessel MV Loch-Ard, skippered by local expert Dale Winward. Explore the Mallacoota Inlet, learn about the area's history and wildlife.
notes_seasonal: Operates seasonally based on demand and weather. Bookings essential.

description_short: Clothing, souvenirs, homewares and giftware in the middle of town, and the place to buy a coach ticket.
description_long: Sue's Bribes has been on Allan Drive for more than fifteen years, selling clothing, souvenirs, homewares, giftware, jewellery and toys, with a range of Mallacoota tea towels, stickers, magnets and t-shirts you will not find anywhere else in town. Stock moves quickly and not all of it is online, so ring if you are after something in particular and Sue will put it aside. There is an online shop with postage around Australia and click-and-collect in store. Sue also sells tickets for the V/Line coach. The shop no longer sells fresh flowers, and no longer hires bikes.
notes_seasonal: Open Tuesday to Saturday, 10am to 2pm. Closed Sunday and Monday. Public holidays and the quiet weeks in winter run differently, so ring before making a special trip. If you are buying a coach ticket, ask Sue for the times rather than trusting a printed timetable: the coach changes often enough that it is worth checking on the day.
kind: Gift shop and coach ticket agent

description_short: Mini golf course in the town centre, next door to and owned by the Mallacoota Surf Shack.
description_long: An outdoor mini golf course in the town centre, its holes laid out around a sandy courtyard. It is its own attraction, next door to the Mallacoota Surf Shack and owned by it. Signed Surf Shack Mini Golf; ask at the shop.

description_short: Locally made, high-quality candles perfect for gifts or a personal treat.
description_long: Handcrafted candles made locally in Mallacoota, often featuring scents inspired by the surrounding natural environment. Available online or potentially through local stockists.
notes_seasonal: Check website for purchase options and stockists.
